game.name: Postal 2
game.desc: Postal 2 is a 2003 first-person shooter developed by Running with Scissors. Spend a week as the Postal Dude in Paradise, Arizona, completing errands in any order, peacefully or violently. Requires your own game files from Steam plus the freeware multiplayer build.

game.name: Postal 2 MP (first run)
game.desc: One-time setup step for Postal 2. Boots the freeware Share the Pain multiplayer build so the game generates its configuration files, then quit with Start+Select. Run this once before launching Postal 2.
